resources.string: CEONIX Ride Helper
Before you start

Your head unit cannot read its own Wi‑Fi address — Android hides it from apps. This phone can see it, so this app looks it up and hands it over.\n\nOpen Settings › Wi‑Fi Setup on the head unit, and make sure Android Auto is not connected.

This app needs location and nearby‑devices permission. Android requires it to read Wi‑Fi networks; nothing is stored or sent anywhere else.
Turn on Location in your phone settings. Android returns no Wi‑Fi networks while it is off.
